crop.notes: The whole item 'The McCoole and Allen Fight' is there; the top of the clipping also holds the bottom of an unrelated weather (barometer/thermometer) table.

ocr.notes: Weather table garbled and some letter errors in names ('McC le', 'Allkn', 'June 1b' for June 15), but the article text is mostly right.

summary.suggested: The Missouri Republican reported that the last $500-a-side deposit for the $1,000 match between Tom Allen and Mike McCoole was made at McCoole's saloon, with the fight set for Tuesday, June 15.

metadata.notes: The page masthead reads 'The Missouri Republican--St. Louis, June 9, 1869.' The St. Louis Republic name dates only from 1888.

facts.fact: The final $500-a-side deposit was made at McCoole's saloon for the $1,000-a-side match between Allen and Mike McCoole, set for June 15, 1869

notes: Capt. Tom Kehoe acted for McCoole and Wm. Carroll for Allen in making the deposit. The item is entirely about the match, so focus is primary.
